id: title:jonmcwest:extract fields from a selected json attribute

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a bounded, opt-in capability to ingest structured JSON from selected log attributes alongside the body, with shared resource budgets and team allowlist gating.
review.reason: The chunk contains the implementation of the JSON attribute extraction path, including the dedicated enrichment function, shared budget enforcement, PII handling, and corresponding metrics. It also includes the configuration option and its consumption, establishing a complete, bounded capability rather than just documentation or partial implementation. This represents a substantive
review.uncertainty: Tier 3 not assigned because the implementation does not demonstrate systemic risk reduction across broader components or critical paths, and no release notes or adoption metrics are supplied. Tier 1 not assigned because the chunk includes implementation and configuration, not just documentation.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a documentation and test-only change. No implementation, configuration, or shared library changes are supplied, so tier and benefit cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: the markdown now distinguishes between enrichment skips by body size and by selected attribute, and adds a note that a record can increment the counter more than once.
observations.code_quote: Each selected object contributes at most 50 fields; each nested array counts as one field. The depth, node, and byte budgets described above apply, including validation of the contents of retained arrays. Over-budget extraction adds no fields from that source. The combined record must remain within the shared 1 MiB content budget.
